name: W-4 Payroll Deductions Calculator
meta_title: W-4 Payroll Deductions Calculator for 2026 Withholding
meta_description: Find the federal tax withheld from your paycheck under the 2026 IRS Pub. 15-T method for your Form W-4, plus FICA, 401(k), benefits and state tax.
subtitle: Work out the federal income tax withheld from one paycheck with the 2026 IRS percentage method, then Social Security, Medicare and your other deductions. Personal exemptions and withholding allowances are no longer part of Form W-4, so the calculator uses its Steps 2 to 4, with an option for older allowance-based forms still on file.
